records.text: According to its website, Phoenix Dream Center provides residential rehabilitation, shelter, and care for human-trafficking victims.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Phoenix Dream Center, ... according to their website, ... is a center that provides residential rehabilitation, ... shelter and care for victims of human trafficking.

verification.notes: Phoenix Dream Center and Arizona public-service materials describe residential recovery, safe beds/housing, behavioral and medical care, and a dedicated human-trafficking restoration program. This substantially confirms the statement.

sources.title: Phoenix Dream Center: What We Do
sources.relevance: Describes safe beds, medical and behavioral care, recovery programs, and links the trafficking program.

sources.relevance: Arizona public listing describes holistic residential recovery services for trafficking survivors.
